app.title: Show HN: TERMy – A fast terminal assistant that does not use LLMs
app.author: gioscarab
app.description: TERMy is a terminal assistant CLI that provides quick contextual information without relying on large language models.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and run `cargo install --path .` to build the binary.
Execute `termy --help` to ensure CLI is responsive.
Run `termy info` on a sample directory and verify output format.
Measure execution time for a command with and without network calls.
